name: Domino's
description: Draft adapter that reads the active Domino's store menu and deals, builds configured products, adds products or deals to the current cart without checkout, and opens or closes the cart overlay.

tools.name: list_dominos_menu_categories
tools.description: List menu categories available at the currently selected Domino's store.

tools.name: get_dominos_category
tools.description: Return products, base prices, and stable product codes for one menu category at the selected store.

tools.name: get_dominos_product_options
tools.description: Return valid bases, sizes, option groups, toppings, portions, and side choices for a product configuration.

tools.name: list_dominos_deals
tools.description: List current local and national deals for the selected store and service method.

tools.name: get_dominos_cart
tools.description: Return a sanitized summary of the current Domino's cart, including items, deals, and totals.

tools.name: start_dominos_deal
tools.description: Add a currently available deal to the cart so its product slots can be filled.

tools.name: add_dominos_product_to_cart
tools.description: Validate and add one configured product to the current cart, optionally into an active deal.

tools.name: open_dominos_cart
tools.description: Open the Domino's cart overlay on the current page to display items and order summary to the user.

tools.name: close_dominos_cart
tools.description: Close the Domino's cart overlay if it is currently open on the page.
